purpose: Known-answer fixtures for checking cross-owner composition of a single synthetic Highveld panel/service/repair/change scenario.
normative_notice: Every projection is synthetic and represents an owner-boundary test fixture. No live owner payloads, municipal data, building condition, service capacity, professional approval or physical construction are represented.
